map.title: Command map
map.sub: Kodagu district, Karnataka. Real OpenStreetMap basemap; incidents, shelters and depots will stream in live.

pages.feed: Every report from every channel, as it arrives: original text, language, English translation and linked incident.
pages.incidents: Clustered incidents ranked by priority, with the confidence and priority breakdown that explains each rank.
pages.fastVerify: Life-safety reports with low confidence. They are never discarded: call back the reporter or send the nearest team.
pages.plans: Allocation plans from the Coordination agent. Nothing is dispatched until a person approves.
pages.dispatch: Every dispatch from pending to confirmed; overdue deliveries are highlighted.
pages.resources: Inventory per depot, burn rates and projected shortages.
pages.shelters: Capacity, occupancy, last confirmation and access status of every shelter.
pages.alerts: Shortages, blackouts, inaccessible shelters, rumours and overdue deliveries.
pages.phone: A mock phone: send an SMS or record a voice call in any language and watch it reach the dashboard.
pages.scenario: The disaster digital twin: start a scenario, inject events and speed up time.
pages.twin3d: A 3D view of the active scenario that changes with every scenario and event.
pages.metrics: Evaluation on a labelled synthetic dataset. Evaluated on synthetic data; real-world validation pending.
pages.audit: Every agent action and human decision, with inputs and outputs.
pages.field: Mobile field reporting that works offline and syncs later.
pages.radio: Enter reports received by HAM radio, police wireless, forest/railway radio or satellite phone.
pages.blackout: Silent zones ranked by risk: hazard, population, silence, infrastructure loss and missing-contact reports.
pages.about: The story: what RELAY does, who does what, and the evidence behind it.
